clue.text: Insufficiently emphasise how one may be tense?

definitions.meaning: to give a word or syllable too little weight in speech
a person who is tense or anxious may be said to be in a state of pressure, read as a two-word phrase

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a verb for giving too little stress; split into two words it describes a person feeling pressure.

clue.text: Court officials chaired on high

parts.note: on a tennis court the officials who rule on play sit up in tall chairs beside the net

explanation.definitionFit: Tennis match officials sit in raised chairs at courtside, so they are literally chaired on high.

clue.text: It's played up or down

parts.note: a pub game is played; read upwards in this down light, the same letters spell a Stradivarius violin, which is also played

explanation.walkthrough: Read up the grid the letters give STRAD, a Stradivarius violin, which is also played.
explanation.definitionFit: The pub game of arrows thrown at a board is played, and its letters reversed give another played thing.

clue.text: Suspect messenger is one craftily dodging duty

parts.note: suspect, in the sense odd or dubious, is rum in British slang
a runner carries messages

explanation.surface: A dubious courier turns out to be a smuggler avoiding customs charges.
explanation.walkthrough: RUM is British slang for odd or suspect; the 'duty' is customs duty on alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: A smuggler of alcohol evades the customs duty payable on spirits, often by stealth.

clue.text: We hear it's bound to be a current variation

indicators.note: we hear tells us the word for bound is to be taken as spoken, not as spelt

parts.note: bound means tied up

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that something is certain to be the latest trend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bound to be' tempts as 'certain to be', but 'bound' is the word for tied.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea's rise and fall is a regular change in ocean currents and water level.

clue.text: Let a case get out of hand and snowball

indicators.note: things that get out of hand go into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Allowing a legal dispute to run unchecked lets it grow and grow.
explanation.definitionFit: To snowball is to grow rapidly and uncontrollably, just as a dispute may intensify.

clue.text: It's impressive, even when made of rubber

definitions.text: It's impressive, even when made of rubber

parts.words: It's impressive, even when made of rubber
parts.note: a device that presses an inked image onto paper makes an impression, and office ones are commonly rubber

explanation.definitionFit: A rubber office tool presses an inked mark onto paper, so it literally makes an impression.

clue.text: Writer's block?

parts.note: not a creative stall but a literal block of paper sheets that a writer jots on

explanation.definitionFit: A pad of paper sheets bound together is a block used by someone writing.

clue.text: One should admit when one is depressed

definitions.text: One should admit when one is depressed

parts.words: One should admit when one is depressed
parts.note: a push-button at the front door, when pressed down, should lead to visitors being let in

explanation.definitionFit: Pressing the button by the entrance rings to request entry, so pressing it leads to admission.

clue.text: One might aid camper that's collapsed

definitions.text: One might aid camper that's collapsed

indicators.note: collapsed suggests something fallen into a jumble, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A medic might help a holidaymaker who has fainted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's collapsed' rearranges AIDCAMPER, and the whole clue describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambulance crew member would come to help a fainting holidaymaker.

clue.text: A place to see pigeons in the air

parts.note: pigeons are kept in a loft

explanation.surface: A pigeon fancier points out where the birds are kept, high up.
explanation.definitionFit: Overhead or up high, as a bird in flight is.

clue.text: Some offer is questionable, being rather suggestive

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a proposal seems dubious because it is a bit indecent.
explanation.definitionFit: Slightly indecent or racy, as a suggestive remark or joke is.

clue.text: Applaud actor's role — but on reflection, it's rubbish

parts.note: to applaud is to clap

indicators.note: a reflection shows things back to front, so the word for role is turned around

parts.note: an actor plays a part

explanation.surface: A critic first claps a performance, then reconsiders and calls it nonsense.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretentious nonsense or empty talk is called rubbish.

clue.text: Season well

definitions.meaning: one of the four times of year
a well is a source of water from the ground

explanation.definitionFit: It is the season after winter and also a natural water source rising from the ground.

clue.text: Firm, lean sort of fighting man

indicators.note: to sort letters is to rearrange them into a new order

explanation.surface: A firm, lean physique suits a kind of soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier armed with a rifle is a fighting man of a particular kind.

clue.text: He comes in to wait, finally

indicators.note: comes in says the word for he enters the middle of the other piece

parts.note: to attend on someone is to wait on them
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man arrives to wait in a queue, at last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to wait' suggests waiting in line, but the sense is waiting on someone, as a servant attends.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrase meaning lastly or eventually, used as an adverb like finally.

clue.text: Incautious way the staff leave school assembly?

definitions.text: way the staff leave school assembly?
definitions.meaning: the school's principal goes out ahead of everyone else

explanation.definitionFit: Diving in rashly is plunging in skull foremost; at assembly the principal leads the staff out.

clue.text: Point to publication that's revolting

definitions.note: the definition is an adjective phrase; the answer is the noun for incitement to rebel

parts.note: S is south, a compass point
an edition is an issue of a publication

explanation.surface: A critic directs readers to a disgusting new book.
explanation.definitionFit: Conduct or speech stirring people to rebel against the state, matching a revolting crowd in the rebellion sense.

clue.text: Damaged document put inside another

indicators.note: put inside says one document's word goes into the middle of the other's

parts.note: another document here, a deed being a legal document
a form is an official document

explanation.surface: A filing clerk spoils paperwork by stuffing one sheet into another.
explanation.definitionFit: Misshapen or disfigured, as something damaged out of its proper form is.

clue.text: State customs require travellers to do so

definitions.meaning: to state is to announce or say formally

definitions.text: customs require travellers to do so
definitions.meaning: at the customs desk travellers must list goods that carry duty

explanation.definitionFit: To announce formally, and what passengers must do with dutiable goods at border control.

clue.text: An ABC-man, say?

parts.note: an AB is an able seaman, so an AB-seaman, sounding like ABC-man, is a mariner

explanation.definitionFit: An able seaman, abbreviated AB, is a member of a ship's crew.

clue.text: Remedy may be to change gear

definitions.meaning: to remedy is to put right a wrong

explanation.definitionFit: Means to set right a wrong, and read with a hyphen, to put clothes on again.

clue.text: Lime and cats affected plant

indicators.note: affected here means acted upon and altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gardener's shrub suffers from lime in the soil and visiting cats.
explanation.definitionFit: A climbing garden plant with showy flowers, a specific example of a plant.

clue.text: Athenian garret

definitions.meaning: relating to ancient Athens or its region, Attica
a small room at the top of a house under the roof

explanation.definitionFit: An adjective for things of Athens, and also a top-floor room under the eaves.

clue.text: RAF cooks getting help making chicken

indicators.note: to cook something is to alter it, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: Air force chefs receive assistance in preparing a chicken dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooks' rearranges RAF (the Royal Air Force) to AFR. 'chicken' suggests the bird but means cowardly.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicken is slang for cowardly, meaning scared or fearful.

clue.text: In principle, ring after eleven in the morning

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the abbreviation for morning

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, is the morning

indicators.note: after puts the ring shape following the number

parts.note: XI is eleven in Roman numerals
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: In theory, a phone call arrives just after eleven o'clock in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In principle' reads as 'in theory', but only 'principle' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-evident truth or accepted rule serves as a basic principle.

clue.text: Once-powerful Russian arts organisation

indicators.note: organisation is arranging, so the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A former Russian magnate sets up a cultural body.
explanation.definitionFit: The emperor of Russia before 1917 held absolute power that has since ended.

clue.text: Sailor a short distance nearer the stern

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
FT, foot or feet, is a short unit of distance

explanation.surface: A seaman moves a little way towards the back of the ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A nautical word meaning towards or at the rear of a vessel.

clue.text: Double description of a batman?

parts.note: a batman is an army officer's servant, so he is both employed as a servant and enlisted in the armed forces

explanation.walkthrough: A batman is an officer's personal servant in the British Army.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both working as a domestic servant and serving in the military.

clue.text: Protects men's involvement in minor setback

indicators.note: involvement suggests things twisted together, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive adds no letter, giving men

explanation.surface: A guard shields workers caught up in a small mishap.
explanation.definitionFit: An unexpected awkward mishap or hitch is a minor setback.
